messages:
akeem: Quick flag - eu1 canary for model-serve v3.2.1 failing immediately. Build shows a transitive package bump in our eu1 image pipeline that removes symbol `syncKV` from libfastkv. Need expedited approval to pin eu1 to previously validated image and skip the eu1 canary step.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: model-serve:v3.2.1 -> eu1 (10% traffic)
Status: FAILED (healthcheck 502)
Logs:
```
ERROR dlopen libfastkv.so.1.4.2: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
Undefined symbol: syncKV
```

ops_jen: Do other regions show the same?

akeem: us-west and staging fine. eu1 uses custom packaging and a different private mirror; looks like that mirror got the bumped lib yesterday.

riley_sre: Observed ~5% error increase on the canary traffic path that hits KV. If we want to avoid user impact, best option is to pin eu1 to `model-serve:v3.2.0-eu1-frozen` which we sanity-checked last week. Rollback plan: immediate revert to v3.2.0 if pin doesn't stabilize.

tara_product: Any customer-visible failures so far? SLAs?

riley_sre: No SLA breach yet, only internal errors for some batch inference. No pages yet.

release-lead-bot: ACTION: expedited approval requested outside change window. Please respond with +1 / -1. Include scope and rollback criteria.

akeem: Proposed: apply image pin on eu1 daemonset, keep global rollout paused, run 30m smoke watch. Commands: 
```
kubectl -n prod set image ds/model-serve model-serve=model-serve:v3.2.0-eu1-frozen --context=eu1
deployctl pause rollout --service model-serve --regions eu1
```

ops_jen: Add explicit revert trigger: if 5xx > 1% for 10m, revert to v3.2.0 and page SRE. Also enable temporary alert: `eu1.modelserve.5xx > 0.01 for 10m`.

tara_product: I can sign off for eu1-only expedited fix. Please update release notes: "Hotfix: Pin eu1 image to avoid packaging dependency regression."

release-lead-bot: +1 (release lead) - expedite approved for eu1 only, require postmortem.

riley_sre: +1 from SRE on-call, will monitor and ready to flip the revert.

ops_jen: +1 from ops contingent on exact commands and rollout logs. Also request that akeem posts the rollout watch output here.

akeem: Applying pin now, will stream rollout output.

deploy-bot: Command executed: set image -> model-serve:v3.2.0-eu1-frozen on ds/model-serve (eu1). Rollout: 4/4 updated, 0 unavailable.

akeem: Quick smoke checks: /health -> 200, sample inference -> success, first batch job kick -> queued, no immediate errors in logs.

release-lead-bot: Draft release note entry: "Hotfix: Pinned eu1 model-serve image to v3.2.0-eu1-frozen to mitigate packaging dependency regression causing canary failures. Applied via expedited approval; postmortem to follow."

tara_product: Fine to add to customer changelog as a short note. Keep monitoring.

riley_sre: We'll keep the temporary alert live for 24h and monitor for 30m. If stable, we'll mark as resolved and schedule a rebuild of the eu1 image without the broken package.

akeem: 30m passed, no sustained 5xx spike. Leaving alert for 24h. Opening postmortem ticket and attaching build logs/timestamps.

release-lead-bot: Recording decision: scope=eu1-only, mitigation=pin-image, postmortem=required, decision_state=resolved. :white_check_mark:

akeem: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the postmortem once we rebuild the eu1 image and reconcile the mirror.
